provenance: Synthetic, fabricated, rule-derived assessment cases. These are not actual messages and are not user-adjudicated gold labels. Expected sets reflect the rules profile; ambiguous cases intentionally accept multiple dispositions.
cutoff_policy: Inbox messages older than 30 days or with unknown received dates remain protected unless an explicit item-specific user instruction overrides protection.

cases.scenario: A software license record is in Inbox and was received 31 days before the frozen run start.

email.subject: License record for workstation A-17
email.body: Your annual license remains active through December 31. Keep this receipt for your records. No action is requested.
email.thread_context: No prior or later thread messages are included.

cases.scenario: An old Inbox message contains a concrete, still unresolved request for a device serial. Preserve Inbox protection; an existing task can be retained as context without inventing a task solely from age or authorizing a reply.

task_expectation.review_guidance: The email itself contains a real unresolved request for a serial number. Preserve that existing to-do context if represented, but do not invent a new task merely because the old message is protected. No instruction authorizes sending a reply.

email.subject: Case 418 remains open
email.body: We still need the device serial number to finish troubleshooting. Reply with the serial when convenient. The case remains open.
email.thread_context: No prior or later thread messages are included.

cases.scenario: A recent benefits message uses a recipient alias whose relationship to the portal is not established by available evidence. The actual recipient is visible, the relationship is uncertain, and the profile change may be material.

task_expectation.review_guidance: No account profile establishes the alias relationship. Preserve this uncertainty; do not claim a proven mismatch.

email.subject: Review your coverage selection

cases.scenario: Two physical copies share a full Message-ID but have distinct current numeric IDs; this item is a redundant informational copy.

email.subject: Order 7721 received
email.body: Your order was received. This is an informational receipt; the item is already delivered.
email.thread_context: Two physically distinct saved copies are present. Copy A: account synthetic-mailbox, full Message-ID <synthetic-0008@example.invalid>, current Mail ID 7009. Copy B: same account and full Message-ID, current Mail ID 7010. This record is copy B.

email.thread_context: Earlier: user submitted a cancellation request. Later evidence shown here is acknowledgment only.
